request: Reprocess exactly these seven externally sourced recipes and no others after validated mapping, writing, and auditing corrections: https://www.savorytooth.com/instant-pot-broccoli-cheese-soup/ ; https://joyfilledeats.com/spinach-and-ricotta-stuffed-chicken/ ; https://www.ruled.me/jalapeno-chicken-skillet-meal/ ; https://www.ruled.me/keto-chicken-pesto-zoodle-salad/ ; https://www.myketokitchen.com/keto-recipes/one-pan-low-carb-cauliflower-carbonara/ ; https://www.castironketo.net/blog/keto-creamy-tuscan-zucchini-noodles-with-sausage/ ; https://www.ruled.me/low-carb-chili-kick/ .
